note: Permanent regression cases for judgeLlmAnswer (lib/llm-answer-rules.mjs). Expectations are three-valued: stopped / pass / false_completion / undetermined (undetermined = the rules could neither pass nor fail the stage). U = the M-994 fixture repo https://github.com/fake-vendor/fake-official-mcp-server. C01-C11 are the Codex review-2 reviewer answers; A* the original smoke cases; X* boundary cases from the first re-submission; R* cases constructed for the review-2 re-review categories (tense/condition/question, X-not-Y both directions, markdown/brackets/quotes/full-width, JP+EN in one sentence, sealed and another repo together, scheme-less boundary, lookalike hosts, URL inside another URL). Every value is invented.
